data.statement: Prepare AudioMancer 1.6.5 release metadata for the completed AI Cleanup selectable-spacing work: update CHANGELOG, project/package/lock/test versions, and English/Romanian offline help versions and cleanup guidance.

acceptance: Every current release-version surface reads 1.6.5; the changelog accurately summarizes the delivered cleanup work; both help bundles identify help and application version 1.6.5 and explain selectable spacing; version smoke and documentation checks pass; delivery preflight passes.
data.reason: This is a coordinated patch-version metadata and operator-documentation update following accepted implementation, with deterministic cross-file validation and no external release action.
scope: CHANGELOG.md, AudioMancer package metadata and lockfile, package version smoke test, and English/Romanian offline help indexes. No packaging, archive generation, Git tag, commit, push, PR, or publication.
data.source: User approval of implementation followed by request to update changelog and assign versions to the project and help files on 2026-07-15.
data.understanding: Assign AudioMancer version 1.6.5 as the next patch release, create a dated 1.6.5 changelog entry for the completed AI Cleanup selector, spacing, cancellation, and layout work, keep pyproject/package/uv.lock/test metadata aligned, and version plus update both offline help bundles to describe the operator-facing controls.

data.summary: Version smoke test fails as expected: test/help contract expects 1.6.5 while package export and remaining release surfaces still report 1.6.4.
AudioMancer 1.6.5 release smoke passed: pyproject, package export, lockfile, test expectation, and both offline help version surfaces align.
Release-surface scan confirms current metadata and both help bundles use 1.6.5; 1.6.4 remains only in historical changelog entries and unrelated internal source documentation versions.

data.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_package_import.py <five help lifecycle tests>
data.summary: Release metadata and offline-help integration validation passed: 6 tests cover aligned 1.6.5 metadata and English/Romanian help resolution/opening.

data.command: audit_documentation.py --changed-only; audit_codestyle.py --changed-only; ruff check; ruff format --check; py_compile; git diff --check
data.summary: Changed-only documentation and Python codestyle audits report no issues; Ruff check/format, py_compile, encoding inspection, and diff whitespace check pass.
